flagged.evidence: Proof 4.1 states, “The set of such r has full Lebesgue measure and is dense in Ω,” without justifying or citing that every nonempty open subset of the quotient torus has positive quotient-Lebesgue measure. That fact follows immediately because each nonempty open set contains a nondegenerate coordinate box, so this is a nonfatal omitted proof step. The density extension appears unnecessary for the later almost-everywhere conclusion.
